library_contributions_experience.name: library_contributions_experience
library_contributions_experience.value:
("library_contributions"."experience_year" IS NULL AND "library_contributions"."experience_month" IS NULL AND "library_contributions"."experience_day" IS NULL)
    OR ("library_contributions"."experience_year" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999 AND
      (("library_contributions"."experience_month" IS NULL AND "library_contributions"."experience_day" IS NULL) OR
       ("library_contributions"."experience_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND ("library_contributions"."experience_day" IS NULL OR
        CASE WHEN "library_contributions"."experience_year" BETWEEN 1 AND 9999 AND "library_contributions"."experience_month" BETWEEN 1 AND 12
        THEN "library_contributions"."experience_day" BETWEEN 1 AND extract(day from (make_date("library_contributions"."experience_year", "library_contributions"."experience_month", 1) + interval '1 month - 1 day'))
        ELSE false END)))) IS TRUE

library_works_creator_length.name: library_works_creator_length
library_works_creator_length.value: "library_works"."creator" IS NULL OR char_length("library_works"."creator") BETWEEN 1 AND 200

library_works_url.name: library_works_url
library_works_url.value: "library_works"."reference_url" IS NULL OR (char_length("library_works"."reference_url") BETWEEN 1 AND 2048 AND "library_works"."reference_url" ~* '^https?://[^[:space:]]+$')

occurrences_shared_generation_once_idx.name: occurrences_shared_generation_once_idx
occurrences_shared_generation_once_idx.where: "task_occurrences"."responsibility_member_id" IS NULL AND "task_occurrences"."generation_date" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."status" <> 'archived'

occurrences_individual_generation_once_i.name: occurrences_individual_generation_once_idx
occurrences_individual_generation_once_i.where: "task_occurrences"."responsibility_member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."generation_date" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."status" <> 'archived'

occurrences_shared_no_date_once_idx.name: occurrences_shared_no_date_once_idx
occurrences_shared_no_date_once_idx.where: "task_occurrences"."responsibility_member_id" IS NULL AND "task_occurrences"."generation_date" IS NULL AND "task_occurrences"."status" <> 'archived'

occurrences_individual_no_date_once_idx.name: occurrences_individual_no_date_once_idx
occurrences_individual_no_date_once_idx.where: "task_occurrences"."responsibility_member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."generation_date" IS NULL AND "task_occurrences"."status" <> 'archived'

occurrences_individual_open_carry_once_i.name: occurrences_individual_open_carry_once_idx
occurrences_individual_open_carry_once_i.where: "task_occurrences"."responsibility_member_id" IS NOT NULL AND "task_occurrences"."status" = 'open' AND "task_occurrences"."carry_forward" = true

sports_comments_context_shape.name: sports_comments_context_shape
sports_comments_context_shape.value:
("sports_comments"."context_kind" = 'football_day' AND "sports_comments"."context_event_id" IS NULL AND "sports_comments"."context_date" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("sports_comments"."context_kind" = 'river_match' AND "sports_comments"."context_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_comments"."context_date" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("sports_comments"."context_kind" = 'ufc_card' AND "sports_comments"."context_event_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_comments"."context_date" IS NULL)

sports_events_source_reference_unique_id.name: sports_events_source_reference_unique_idx
sports_events_source_reference_unique_id.where: "sports_events"."external_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."source_provider" IS NOT NULL

sports_events_football_category.name: sports_events_football_category
sports_events_football_category.value: ("sports_events"."kind" = 'football_match' AND "sports_events"."football_category" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."football_category" IN ('river','champions')) OR ("sports_events"."kind" = 'ufc_card' AND "sports_events"."football_category" IS NULL)

sports_events_champions_shape.name: sports_events_champions_shape
sports_events_champions_shape.value: "sports_events"."football_category" IS DISTINCT FROM 'champions' OR ("sports_events"."season_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."round_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."first_team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."second_team_id" IS NOT NULL)

sports_events_football_metadata.name: sports_events_football_metadata
sports_events_football_metadata.value: "sports_events"."kind" = 'football_match' OR ("sports_events"."season_id" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."round_id" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."first_team_id" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."second_team_id" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."tie_reference" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."next_round_id" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."next_slot" IS NULL)

sports_events_distinct_teams.name: sports_events_distinct_teams
sports_events_distinct_teams.value: "sports_events"."first_team_id" IS NULL OR "sports_events"."second_team_id" IS NULL OR "sports_events"."first_team_id" <> "sports_events"."second_team_id"

sports_events_next_slot.name: sports_events_next_slot
sports_events_next_slot.value: "sports_events"."next_slot" IS NULL OR ("sports_events"."next_slot" > 0 AND "sports_events"."next_round_id" IS NOT NULL)

sports_events_status.name: sports_events_status
sports_events_status.value: "sports_events"."status" IN ('scheduled', 'postponed', 'completed', 'cancelled') OR ("sports_events"."football_category" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM 'champions' AND "sports_events"."status" = 'suspended')

sports_events_kind_shape.name: sports_events_kind_shape
sports_events_kind_shape.value:
("sports_events"."kind" = 'football_match' AND "sports_events"."competition" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."first_participant" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."second_participant" IS NOT NULL AND "sports_events"."is_current" = false AND "sports_events"."card_status" IS NULL)
    OR ("sports_events"."kind" = 'ufc_card' AND "sports_events"."competition" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."first_participant" IS NULL AND "sports_events"."second_participant" IS NULL)

sports_fight_results_outcome.name: sports_fight_results_outcome
sports_fight_results_outcome.value: ("sports_fight_results"."outcome" = 'winner' AND "sports_fight_results"."winner_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("sports_fight_results"."outcome" IN ('draw','no_contest','cancelled') AND "sports_fight_results"."winner_id" IS NULL)
